description: Bench S7, the flank reference (D-026, M3 step 7): S6's two equal lines of 8 warriors march into each other head-on; a second Hird squad of 8, 12 m west, marches at the same time onto the raiders' west end and strikes it from the side about 3 s after the lines lock. Batch reports how much sooner a flanked line breaks than in S6 and with how few losses; BalanceReferenceTests pins those numbers. Don't edit it to play: a change here moves the reference.
